scope: Proposition 11.1 of the manuscript “Nonuniqueness with local conservation for the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation” (preprints/Nonuniqueness-with-local-conservation-for-the-hard-sphere-Boltzmann-equation-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 363 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 640850bc08703544), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 65. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are fixed choices K ≥ 1, 0 < η ≤ log 2, 0 < α ≤ 1 4, 0 < γ ≤ 1 with the following property. For every allowed geometric mesh with lower endpoint l ∈ [0, 1], the only nonnegative density solving (9.5) on 0 < t < ∞, with locally integrable gain and loss, the positive-time mild formula (9.15), and the bound g(t, x, v) ≤ (t + l)H(v), is zero. Consequently every nonzero limit in Propositions 9.1 and 10.1 has U < ∞. The four parameters can be fixed before the thermal, seed, bath, and final horizon parameters of the construction. Their choice is independent of the mesh phase and of l.
